parameters.content:
## Read → merge → write → verify
GET the entity, replace only the holiday dates of this bundle, PUT, then GET again and compare. Every HTTP / Supabase error goes to Verify as FAILED.

## Honest result
Success is only reported when the read-back matches. Otherwise the owner gets msg_apply_failed and staff get msg_staff_error. Every write is logged in apply_log with full hours before and after.

## Undo = exact previous hours
UNDO writes back hours_before of the latest SUCCESS APPLY row (within UNDO_WINDOW_HOURS) and verifies the whole hours object matches.

nodeGroups.name: Load and guard bundle
nodeGroups.description: Reads the bundle, its dates and the last apply; checks the allowed status. Read errors alert staff and stop.

nodeGroups.name: Write hours to Yext
nodeGroups.description: Locks the bundle, merges the new holiday hours into the live listing, writes it and reads it back to prove the change.

nodeGroups.name: Log and tell owner
nodeGroups.description: Stores before/after hours, sets the final status and tells the owner the honest result; failures also alert staff.
